_note: Shared frame for the night build. Floor metres (dog, tap3 on the venue floor) are projected onto the map at floor_anchor for the demo; this is a display choice, not a survey.

floor_anchor._doc: floor (0,0) = marker M1; +x east, +y south (image down); rotation clockwise. DEMO SCALING: 1 floor metre = scale map metres, so the 6 x 4 m venue floor stands in for a 300 x 200 m search sector. Shown on screen.
